ChooseDevices: Choose a microphone and output first.
NoCable: VB-Cable was not found. Refresh devices after installing it, or choose another output.
Presetnatural: Gentler suppression to preserve speech details; more noise may remain.
Presetstudio: Balanced suppression without EQ or compression.
Presetpodcast: Clearer speech with a low-frequency filter and compression.
Presetmax: Stronger suppression may affect speech details.
BalancedHint: 60 ms buffer: a good starting point for most devices.
StableHint: 100 ms buffer: tolerates scheduling jitter with more latency.
FastHint: 30 ms buffer: less latency, with a higher risk of dropouts.
ActiveStatus: Running with {0}. Select CABLE Output in your calling app.
Format: Input: {0} | Processing: 48 kHz mono | Algorithmic delay: {1:0} ms | Buffer target: {2} ms. Device latency is additional.
Metrics: Slowest frame: {0:0.0} ms / 10 ms | Queued audio: {1:0} ms | Output dropouts: {2}
ClippingDetail: Lower the microphone level in Windows or reduce input gain.
GapDetail: Stop processing and try More stable; close CPU-heavy apps.
Slow: Processing is near its real-time limit
SlowDetail: Each frame lasts 10 ms; try RNNoise if the counter increases.
HealthyDetail: If speech still crackles, try Softer sound; the denoising model may be responsible.
PreservedGate: The voice gate stays disabled; stop denoising before enabling it.
DirectRouting: This output plays audio directly. For calls, select CABLE Input. Use headphones.
WaitingDataDetail: No new measurements have arrived. Check the microphone connection and Windows permissions.
ErrorModelMissing: DeepFilterNet3 model is missing. Reinstall the complete application folder.
ErrorModelIntegrity: The DeepFilterNet3 model file is damaged or does not match the expected version.
ErrorAbi: Update the entire application folder; the DeepFilterNet library version does not match the application.
ErrorOldNative: The DeepFilterNet library is outdated. Extract the new version into a new folder and run it from there.
ErrorMissingNative: The DeepFilterNet library is missing. Reinstall the complete application, or select RNNoise.
ErrorNativeArch: The DeepFilterNet library must be built for Windows x64.
ErrorModelMetadata: The model does not match the required 48 kHz sample rate and 10 ms frames.
ErrorOverload: Processing or the audio device cannot keep up in real time. Try RNNoise or close CPU-heavy applications.
TrayKeepsAudio: Denoising continues in the background. Double-click the icon to restore the window.
TrayHiddenInfo: Double-click the icon to open the app. Right-click to start or stop denoising, or exit.
TrayUnavailable: The notification tray icon is unavailable; normal taskbar minimization is available.
AutomaticHint: Starts with balanced buffering and monitors performance. Recommendations appear in Health; applying them restarts denoising.
Presetcalls: Calls with gentle compression and a conservative 6 dB gate, 300 ms hold; speech below the noise may still be affected.
Presetstreaming: More presence and moderate compression for streaming. Watch the level meter for clipping.
Presetweakmic: Adds 6 dB input gain and gentle compression. If the microphone clips, lower its level in Windows.
Presetwhisper: Gentler denoising without a voice gate to preserve quiet speech and whispers.
AdviceEnableAuto: Select Automatic buffering to monitor your device and receive recommendations.
AdviceObserving: Monitoring processing time and gaps for 5 seconds…
AdviceHealthy: Performance has been stable in the recent observation window.
AdviceMoreBuffer: Gaps or near-budget processing detected. Try Stable mode for a larger buffer.
AdviceLightweight: DeepFilterNet3 repeatedly exceeded the processing budget. Try lighter RNNoise with the voice gate disabled.
AdviceCheckDevice: The device or processing is unstable. Check connections and close demanding apps.
RecordHint: Record 10 seconds using the current microphone and settings. Original and processed audio are delay-aligned and loudness-matched by reducing the louder version. Audio stays in local memory until you close the app; use headphones.
RecordReady: Recording ready. Listen to both versions at matched loudness.
RecordDisableBypass: Turn off processing bypass before recording a comparison.
PreviewWarning: Listening stops live denoising to avoid microphone feedback. Press Start denoising when finished. The test playback device does not change your call output.
StartupOption: Start with Windows — minimized to the tray
StartupHint: Optional for the current user. Starts denoising with saved devices and settings only when both devices are available; missing devices trigger a notice. Mic test recording never starts automatically.
StartupInstallFirst: Install the app or run MicDenoiser.exe to enable Windows startup.
StartupMissingDevices: Saved devices are unavailable. Open the app and select microphone and output before starting denoising.
DeviceDisconnected: An audio device disconnected. Denoising stopped; reconnect it or choose another device, then start again.
DeviceAudioStopped: Denoising stopped because of an audio problem. Review the error details and reselect devices if needed.
DeviceChooseAgain: Choose microphone and output, then start denoising.
DeviceWatchUnavailable: Device connection monitoring is unavailable. Refresh devices after changing your microphone.
MixerHint: Manual controls for singing and voice-over. Start with small adjustments, watch gain reduction and output protection, and compare using the headphone test. Effects cannot repair microphone clipping already captured.
SignalChain: Input → High-pass → Denoise / blend → Optional gate → EQ → De-esser → Compressor → Output protection
EqCurveHint: Target EQ/high-pass curve shown within ±24 dB; excludes denoising and dynamics. Frequency axis is logarithmic. Higher Q means a narrower band.
InputHint: If input approaches 0 dBFS, lower the microphone level in Windows or on your audio interface.
CompressionHint: For voice-over, start at 2:1. Slower attack preserves word onsets; make-up gain can engage output protection.
DeEsserHint: Reduces the high band during strong sibilance while retaining the voice body. Start with 3–6 dB and tune the frequency to your voice.
CeilingHint: Soft sample-peak protection, not True Peak. If reduction stays high, lower gain ahead of protection to retain a natural sound.
QuickToneHint: Simple tone adjustments add to the parametric EQ; their effect appears in the curve.
Presetsinging: Denoising and gate are off to preserve notes, with gentle 1.5:1 compression. Increase wet mix cautiously if needed; DeepFilterNet is designed for speech and can alter singing.
Presetvoiceover: Gentler 25 dB suppression, soft 2:1 compression, subtle EQ and up to 3 dB de-essing.
Presetbroadcast: Broadcast tone with depth, clarity and 3:1 compression. Compare and reduce effects if the voice sounds artificial.
EffectsLoaded: Effects loaded; current engine, devices and buffering are preserved.
ExportWavHint: Exports the 10-second test as 48 kHz mono Float32 WAV, at captured levels without preview loudness matching. Suitable for importing into a recording app; export does not increase source precision.
SpatialHint: For singing, start with a light effect and headphones. Effects run after compression, before the output ceiling, and are saved with your settings. Use Natural singing or Disable effects for a dry voice.
ReverbHint: Start at 10–15%. Pre-delay preserves word clarity; a longer decay gives a hall feel.
EchoHint: 80–120 ms for slapback. Keep level and feedback low for speech; echo is a creative effect, not room-echo cancellation.
ChorusHint: A modulated delayed voice adds thickness. Start at 10%. Output is mono; chorus does not correct pitch.
Presetvocalroom: Natural singing with 12% room reverb and 0.6 s decay; speech suppression and gate are off.
Presetvocalhall: Natural singing with 22% hall reverb, 1.8 s decay and 35 ms pre-delay.
Presetslapback: Natural singing with 16% slapback echo, 100 ms interval and low feedback.
FastSingingHint: Change while stopped. Keeps the mixer/effects and skips the denoising model and speech gate.
FastSingingActive: Direct path: model/gate delay is zero. Buffers and devices still add latency; start with headphones.
QuickLevelsHint: Start at 0 dB. Open Studio view for EQ, dynamics and effects; changing the view preserves your settings.
AbHint: Save your settings in A, adjust and save B, then record the mic test and prepare the comparison. The same input is rendered twice and preview levels are attenuated to match. Rendering/listening stop live audio; both slots use your current singing path, engine and buffering.
PlayingA: Playing A at a matched level with B; live audio is stopped.
PlayingB: Playing B at a matched level with A; live audio is stopped.
AbRendering: Rendering the same input with both settings; you can cancel.
AbSaveFirst: Save both A and B settings first.
AbRecordFirst: Both settings are saved; record the ten-second mic test.
AbReady: A and B are ready, using the same input at matched levels. Use Stop playback in the mic-test card.
DiagnosticObserving: Collecting audio evidence; start processing and speak.
DiagnosticNoEvidence: No recent level, gap or sustained-load evidence. If crackling persists, try gentler suppression and record before/after.
DiagnosticSourceLevel: The source approaches full scale before app gain. Reduce Windows recording level or interface gain; app attenuation cannot repair earlier distortion.
DiagnosticInputGain: Input gain pushes the signal above full scale. Try reducing it by 3 dB and watch the meter.
DiagnosticProcessingLoad: Several processing windows exceeded the 10 ms frame budget. Try Fast singing for vocals or RNNoise for speech, and reduce system load.
DiagnosticOutputGaps: Output data recently ran short. Stop audio, choose more stable buffering in Studio view, and check the device connection.
DiagnosticOutputPressure: Output protection frequently applies heavy attenuation. Reduce output gain, compressor makeup or effect levels.
DiagnosticCounts: Session: gaps {0} · slow windows {1} · hot source {2} · hot gain {3} · output pressure {4} · worst frame {5:0.00} ms
DiagnosticSaved: Report saved without audio recordings or device names.
DiagnosticHint: These are runtime/level indicators, not proof of a crackle cause. The report contains settings and counters only.
FrameTiming: DSP: p99 ≤ {0:0.000} ms (last {2} frames); session max {1:0.000} ms; ≥10 ms: {3} frames.
HistoryEnable: Keep the last 30 seconds for diagnosis (enable before starting)
HistoryHint: Optional local RAM recording, off by default. Saving stops audio and exports aligned original/processed WAVs at raw levels plus a report. These are DSP output recordings; device/playback crackles may not appear. Files contain your voice and are never uploaded automatically.
HistorySave: Stop and save the last 30 seconds
HistoryEmpty: Enable history before starting audio, then reproduce the issue and save.
HistorySaved: Saved {0:0.0} seconds locally; audio is stopped.
SetupIntro: For calls and streaming, a virtual cable carries the cleaned microphone to your other apps. Studio effects remain in Studio mode.
SetupRoute:
1. Select your physical microphone in MicDenoiser.
2. Set its output to CABLE Input.
3. In Zoom, Discord or OBS, select CABLE Output as the microphone.
SetupInstall: If missing, open the official VB-Audio site, extract the cable installer, run the x64 setup as administrator and restart Windows. Then check again. VB-Cable is a separate third-party installation.
SetupMissing: VB-Cable is missing or one endpoint is disabled.
SetupHeadphones: Use headphones for monitoring. For local recording without a virtual cable, you can choose a normal output and continue. The guide does not install drivers or change other apps.
CompactRunning: Your voice is ready for calls
HoldOriginalHint: Hold with mouse or Space to compare. Use headphones.
LevelHintstrong: Stronger suppression may affect whispers and quiet speech
RemovedNoiseHint: Estimated level difference before effects when speech evidence is low. Requires a quiet interval; does not measure speech quality.
HotkeysReady: Global shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+M mute; Ctrl+Alt+D start / stop.
HotkeysConflict: Some shortcuts are unavailable, possibly used by another app. Buttons and tray commands remain available.
FixApplied: Suggestion applied. Try again and observe the readings.
AboutLocal: Audio is processed on your device. Support links do not send recordings.
WizardOptional: You can continue without VB-Cable for local listening and install it later for calls.
WizardMicHint: Speak now and check the meter. This step does not save audio.
WizardTestHint: Wear headphones, record 10 seconds, then hear the level-matched original and processed clips.
WizardRouteTitle: Set the microphone in your calling app
WizardRouteDiscord: Discord → User Settings → Voice & Video → Input Device
LevelHintcustom: Custom Studio settings; choosing a level replaces the current sound profile.
